description: This source file appears to be a test harness for a library involving AL service communication, specifically testing registration and SDU transmission functionalities using the al_service_* headers. It constructs and sends data units, registers a client, and outputs registration details and MAC addresses.

classes.name: AlServiceAccessPoint

classes.description: A class for creating and configuring registration requests.

classes.name: AlServiceRegistrationResponse
classes.description: A class representing the response received after registration.

classes.name: AlServiceDataUnit
classes.description: A class representing a data unit to be sent over the service access point.

classes.description: Exception class for handling service-related errors.
